My Design Philosphy

"People don't know what they want until you show it to them." - Steve Jobs

Know exactly what you are making and why. If you cannot give a clear definition of your product, that product shouldn’t exist.

A product is designed for its users. The implementation should not only be functional, but intuitive and enjoyable to use.

Even the best product can be overlooked if presented in a careless manner. Present your product in a creative and professional to impute those qualities.
